presets.scene: ONE landscape image (1536x1024), a 3x3 grid of 9 equal LANDSCAPE panels. The panels are separated by solid flat MAGENTA (#FF00FF) gutters about 24px wide, and there is also a 24px solid magenta border around the whole image. Gutters must be pure magenta, perfectly straight, no shadows or gradients. Each panel is a separate painting that fills its panel edge to edge: a wide establishing view of a dangerous dungeon location, seen from its entrance looking in. Each panel must look clearly different from its neighbours (different place, shapes and accent colour).
presets.icons: ONE square image (1024x1024), a 4x4 grid of 16 equal square cells, flat solid MAGENTA background (#FF00FF) everywhere (no gradient, no frames, no grid lines, no shadows on the background). No text, no letters, no numbers. Each cell: one emblem, front view, centered, filling about 75% of the cell, with a clear magenta gap between neighbours. Keep each emblem fully inside its own cell.

Panels left-to-right, top-to-bottom (3 per row):
1. a vaulted city sewer tunnel with murky green water, rat nests of rags and bones on the ledges, a rusty grate; accent sickly green
2. an abandoned silver mine shaft with broken timber supports, a toppled mine cart, faint pale silver veins in the rock, ghostly blue lantern; accent pale silver
3. underground catacombs with walls of stacked skulls, burial niches, old gladiator helmets on graves, candles; accent bone white and cold violet
4. a volcanic cave with rivers of glowing lava, black basalt pillars, a horned skull totem; accent glowing orange
5. the gate of a sunken temple at the edge of a bottomless pit, colossal broken columns, faint purple light rising from below; accent deep violet
6. a hillside bandit cave with a palisade of sharpened stakes, campfire, stolen crates, crude tents; accent campfire orange
7. a huge underground wine cellar, rows of giant barrels, spilled red wine on the floor, broken stairs; accent wine red
